title: descurainia richardsonii subsp. viscosa
intro: Descurainia richardsonii subsp. viscosa, commonly known as sticky tansy mustard, is a plant species within the Brassicaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include supporting digestive health, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Descurainia richardsonii subsp. viscosa include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
